field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable this virtual server

field.label: Service
field.help: Select the service to use.

field.label: Protocol
field.help: Select the protocol to use.

field.label: Server
field.help: DynDNS Server hostname or uri to use (depending on the protocol). When a URI is provided, the tag __MYIP__ will be replaced with the current detected address for this service and __HOSTNAME__ will contain the (comma separated) list of hostnames provided.

field.label: Username
field.help: Username or login to use

field.label: Password
field.help: Password associated with this account

field.label: Authentication
field.help: Access key uses the access key ID (username) and secret access key (password) of an IAM user. The certificate methods exchange a certificate from System: Trust: Certificates for temporary credentials of an IAM role, so no long-term access keys are stored on this firewall.

field.label: Certificate
field.help: Certificate, including its private key, used to authenticate.

field.label: Region
field.help: Region of the IAM Roles Anywhere trust anchor and profile.

field.label: Trust anchor ARN
field.help: IAM Roles Anywhere trust anchor that holds the certificate authority which issued the certificate.

field.label: Profile ARN
field.help: IAM Roles Anywhere profile that lists the role.

field.label: Role ARN
field.help: IAM role to assume, its permissions should be limited to updating the configured records.

field.label: Credential provider endpoint
field.help: AWS IoT credential provider endpoint of your account, as returned by "aws iot describe-endpoint --endpoint-type iot:CredentialProvider".

field.label: Role alias
field.help: AWS IoT role alias that points to the IAM role to assume.

field.label: Thing name
field.help: Name of the AWS IoT thing the certificate is attached to, required when policies use thing variables.

field.label: Wildcard
field.help: add a DNS wildcard CNAME record that points to the configured host.

field.label: Zone
field.help: Zone containing the host entry.

field.label: Hostname(s)
field.help: Hostname to update

field.label: TTL
field.help: Time to Live for the DNS entry

field.label: Check ip method
field.help: How to determine the address to use for this host

field.label: Dynamic ipv6 host
field.help: Swap the interface identifier of the ipv6 address with the given partial ipv6 address (the least significant 64 bits of the address)

field.label: Check ip timeout
field.help: How long to wait before the checkip process times out

field.label: Force SSL
field.help: Force update using HTTPS, please note setting this option will enforce https updates on all accounts as ddclient only supports SSL=yes on a global level (the check ip service may still use HTTP on other services)
